codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What is Roblox Ball vs Ball?
items.answer: Ball vs Ball is a competitive physics-based arena battler on Roblox created by ATYS 3, where players collect unique bouncy balls to battle in 1v1 and 2v2 duels.

items.question: Which ball is best for beginners in Ball vs Ball?
items.answer: Laser Ball and Vampire Ball are the premier starter choices from the coin Gacha, offering high sustained damage and life-steal survivability without requiring paid packs.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Ball vs Ball?
items.answer: Click the yellow gift box icon in the top-left corner of the screen, select Codes from the menu, paste your code, and click Redeem.

items.question: How do hearts and rounds work in Ball vs Ball?
items.answer: Each combatant starts with three hearts. When your ball loses all HP in a round, your character takes direct damage and loses one heart. First player to zero hearts loses.
